options.textMd: All categories have the same rate

explanationMd: Compute the rates separately: Small: 65/100=65%; Standard: 150/200=75%; Family: 210/300=70%. Compare these proportions rather than raw successful counts. The highest rate is 75%.

distractorRationale.a: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 65%, 75%, 70%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
